newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grain prices dominated by currency.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grain prices dominated by currency.

text.p: UK cash grain prices were on a roller coaster ride on Wednesday as the market followed the fluctuations in currency.
"Prices fell first thing this morning when sterling was near to 2.77 against the mark, but now they have come back to almost unchanged as the currency weakens slightly on the day,' said one broker.

"Some people started to panic when sterling dropped a couple of points against the mark, but what they seem to forget is that we are still something like 14 points above this time last week," said another broker.
On the fob market feed wheat traded at 94.50 stg a tonne for Apr/Jun fob east coast ports in early trade but nothing has been reported since.
Delivered milling wheat 11 percent protein in the London area traded at 111 stg for Feb and Apr while 112 stg was paid for Apr/Jun.
Feed wheat in East Anglia traded from 96.50 stg down to 96 then back up to 97.50 stg for Apr/Jun.
In the Avon four range Apr/Jun fetched 97 and 97.50 stg a tonne.
Feed barley in Tilbury traded at 97 for Feb while Mar fetched 96 stg in East Anglia.
"We've not been as busy as Tuesday, but all the same there has been a fair bit done," said one broker. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
